catalyst_rows.indication: agitation in bipolar disorder or schizophrenia, at-home use
catalyst_rows.raw_text: The FDA has assigned a PDUFA target action date of November 14, 2026, which, if approved, would represent the first FDA-approved treatment option for acute agitation associated with bipolar disorders or schizophrenia in the at-home setting.

extractor_notes.tier0_overlap_check: Tier1 adds a day-precision Nov 14, 2026 PDUFA for at-home IGALMI sNDA — sharper than any 10-K disclosure.
